narration: ND | FreeWins and RunItBack step up. The cabinet hums.
RunItBack leads the lifetime series 10–1.
The railbirds crowd in — this one has juice.
Both bars fill. Game one — fight.
ND | FreeWins blocks it all — the round slows to a staring contest at half screen.
RunItBack corners ND | FreeWins and starts the turn that doesn't end.
RunItBack resets the pressure. 106 more off the top, and ND | FreeWins still hasn't had a turn.
ND | FreeWins tries to escape and finds the exit is also covered.
ND | FreeWins touches with Quick Poke — it confirms. 89.
— Marionette Snap! Another 71.
— into Standing Jab. 58 more.
— Apocalypse Bloom for the ender. 45, 263 in all, and the room hears it.
ND | FreeWins touches with Quick Poke — it confirms. 85.
— Marionette Snap keeps it rolling: 68.
— Throw for the ender. 55, 208 in all, and the room hears it.
ND | FreeWins clips RunItBack for 111. The full route was there. The execution wasn't.
ND | FreeWins touches with Quick Poke — it confirms. 108.
— into Marionette Snap. 86 more.
— and Throw CLOSES it. 70 to finish — 264 off one touch.
RunItBack's guard just switches off — dizzied, wide open, and the whole room knows what's coming.
ND | FreeWins leaves Spider Lattice hanging in the air over RunItBack — 124.
RunItBack makes ND | FreeWins terrified to press a single button — 194 over the exchange.
A clean touch for RunItBack, but the hands don't answer — 109 and back to neutral.
RunItBack lands the poke and hesitates on the follow-up. 113, when it could have been the round.
Low. Sweep catches ND | FreeWins standing for 283.
No route needed. Standing Jab, 75, and that's the bar, to bank game one.
Bars reset. 1–0. Game 2 is live. RunItBack walks in with a full bar banked.
ND | FreeWins lets Apocalypse Bloom go and there is nowhere on screen to be! 315 damage.
RunItBack catches ND | FreeWins clean and Cyclone Suplex takes over the whole screen! 388 damage. The poison sets in and ND | FreeWins's bar keeps sliding.
RunItBack touches with Sweep — it confirms. 112.
— Throw! Another 90.
— into Anvil Song. 73 more.
— and Gravedigger CLOSES it. 56 to finish — 331 off one touch.
ND | FreeWins is DIZZY — stars over their head, arms down, and RunItBack has all the time in the world.
RunItBack starts the string and ND | FreeWins BLOCKS it — one hit, two, patient behind the guard…
— so RunItBack just THROWS them out of block: Gravedigger — wide open —
— Sweep lands clean: 55 —
— into Standing Jab. 44 more.
— Gravedigger keeps it rolling: 35.
— Throw for the ender. 27, 161 in all, and the room hears it.
RunItBack takes the set 2–0.
RunItBack stands up: "Downloaded."

postMatch.speaker: ND | FreeWins
postMatch.text: GGs, RunItBack. That mid-set adjustment was clean — teach me that.

whoever loses this is gonna be sick about it

best channel on the platform and it is not close

beats.speaker: RawSuper
beats.text: Arcades like this used to be on every corner. We're the last of something, you know.

beats.speaker: DownBack
beats.text: Everything I labbed just... worked today. Best feeling there is.

beats.speaker: DashBack
beats.text: I've had a WEEK, TheHotSeat, and I'm taking all of it out on you.

narration: QC | NotFree sits down without a word. ND | FreeWins doesn't look at them. Here we go.
ND | FreeWins leads the lifetime series 3–2.
Both bars fill. Game one — fight.
QC | NotFree stands up to block the overhead and eats Sweep low instead. 335.
ND | FreeWins lands the poke and hesitates on the follow-up. 141, when it could have been the round.
QC | NotFree throws Jumping Arc into a block — -10 — and ND | FreeWins takes the free punish: 368.
QC | NotFree's guard just switches off — dizzied, wide open, and the whole room knows what's coming.
ND | FreeWins presses in. QC | NotFree's guard takes the first two clean. Stalemate for half a second…
— so ND | FreeWins just THROWS them out of block: Throw — wide open —
— Quick Poke lands clean: 121 —
— into Marionette Snap. 97 more.
— Throw for the ender. 78, 296 in all, and the room hears it, to bank game one.
They run it back. Game 2.
QC | NotFree confirms into The Vortex… and DROPS it — only 175 of it lands.
ND | FreeWins presses in. QC | NotFree's guard takes the first two clean. Stalemate for half a second…
— so ND | FreeWins just THROWS them out of block: Throw — wide open —
— Quick Poke lands clean: 130 —
— Marionette Snap keeps it rolling: 104.
— into Standing Jab. 85 more.
— and Apocalypse Bloom CLOSES it. 65 to finish — 384 off one touch.
Low. Sweep catches ND | FreeWins standing for 245.
The overhead. Jumping Arc comes down over the guard for 215 — QC | NotFree guessed high when it mattered.
QC | NotFree confirms into The Standard… and DROPS it — only 157 of it lands.
ND | FreeWins splits the screen in two with the puppet — 247 over the exchange.
Spider Lattice comes out at nothing. ND | FreeWins is stuck in it, and QC | NotFree is already moving.
ND | FreeWins grabs QC | NotFree and puts them straight on the floor — 294.
That's the set — ND | FreeWins wins 2–0.

chatter.speaker: DownBack
chatter.text: ND | FreeWins is not human right now.

narration: InstantAir and RunItBack run the customary button check, then it's on.
InstantAir leads the lifetime series 3–2.
The bars flash full and the first game is live.
RunItBack runs Anvil Song straight through InstantAir — 248. Armour broken. InstantAir is standing there open.
InstantAir whirls Marionette Snap through the space RunItBack was standing in — 336. The poison sets in and RunItBack's bar keeps sliding.
The hit lands — Sweep, 99, and RunItBack's hands are already moving.
— into Standing Jab. 79 more.
— Gravedigger! Another 64.
— Throw for the ender. 49, 291 in all, and the room hears it.
RunItBack throws InstantAir across the screen — 331.
RunItBack doesn't reach for anything fancy — a 4f Standing Jab for 10 is all that's left to do, and takes the opener.
They run it back. Game 2.
RunItBack throws Heavy Starter into a block — -10 — and InstantAir takes the free punish: 373.
InstantAir clips RunItBack for 125. The full route was there. The execution wasn't.
RunItBack starts the string and InstantAir BLOCKS it — one hit, two, patient behind the guard…
— then Sweep slips in LOW under the block and it's open —
— Sweep lands clean: 102 —
— Throw keeps it rolling: 81.
— Anvil Song! Another 66.
— and Gravedigger CLOSES it. 51 to finish — 300 off one touch.
RunItBack spins InstantAir into the floor with Gravedigger — 229. InstantAir goes down hard — no quick rise from that.
A clean touch for InstantAir, but the hands don't answer — 120 and back to neutral.
InstantAir confirms into the Touch of Death… and DROPS it — only 179 of it lands.
RunItBack sits down on the block, and InstantAir was waiting for it: Jumping Arc overhead, 203, evening the set at 1–1.
Final game. Match point both ways. The whole arcade holds its breath.
InstantAir gets in behind Puppet Strings — +2 on block — and simply does not leave.
RunItBack blocks the string and takes 132 in chip for the privilege.
RunItBack finds the gap in the string and takes their turn back.
RunItBack gets the hit but can't find the confirm — 101 and the moment passes.
InstantAir throws Blink Cancel into a block — -10 — and RunItBack takes the free punish: 159.
InstantAir stands exactly where Marionette Snap reaches and RunItBack doesn't. 321, and nothing RunItBack has can answer from there.
The hit lands — Jumping Arc, 204, and InstantAir's hands are already moving.
— and Apocalypse Bloom CLOSES it. 164 to finish — 368 off one touch.
InstantAir fills the entire screen with Apocalypse Bloom! 179 damage.
Last hit lands — InstantAir escapes the set 2–1 with 70% left!
InstantAir stands up: "GGs only."

beats.speaker: TierWhore
beats.text: I dropped two confirms in that set. Two. I don't drop those.

beats.speaker: TheHotSeat
beats.text: You didn't used to have to hit them under that much pressure.

beats.speaker: TierWhore
beats.text: Nobody applied it like that before.

beats.speaker: TheHotSeat
beats.text: Right. So it's not the hands.

beats.speaker: BracketDemon
beats.text: You're not blocking low against me anymore, you're just eating it and going for the throw after.

beats.speaker: PuppetMain
beats.text: Yeah. Costs less than guessing wrong twice.

beats.speaker: BracketDemon
beats.text: Huh. I'd have argued with you about that before.

beats.speaker: PuppetMain
beats.text: Argue with me now, I've got nothing else going on.

narration: RunItBack cracks their knuckles as PuppetMain picks their character.
Somebody calls "next" and gets waved off. Nobody is interrupting this.
Both bars fill. Game one — fight.
PuppetMain spins into Marionette Snap and catches RunItBack on the way round — 273.
RunItBack clips PuppetMain for 108. The full route was there. The execution wasn't.
RunItBack takes the legs — Sweep goes under the standing block for 307.
RunItBack gets the hit but can't find the confirm — 103 and the moment passes.
A clean touch for RunItBack, but the hands don't answer — 114 and back to neutral.
That's the stun. PuppetMain is stood there swaying and RunItBack gets to pick literally anything.
RunItBack starts the string and PuppetMain BLOCKS it — one hit, two, patient behind the guard…
— then RunItBack goes OVER the top: Jumping Arc, and the guard cracks open —
— Standing Jab lands clean: 138 —
— and Judgment Drop CLOSES it. 110 to finish — 248 off one touch, and takes the opener.
They run it back. Game 2. RunItBack walks in with a full bar banked.
PuppetMain touches with Quick Poke — it confirms. 112.
— Marionette Snap! Another 89.
— Standing Jab keeps it rolling: 72.
— Apocalypse Bloom for the ender. 56, 329 in all, and the room hears it.
PuppetMain holds the block on Heavy Starter, sees -18, and makes RunItBack pay 321 for it.
PuppetMain takes the legs — Sweep goes under the standing block for 215.
PuppetMain throws Quick Poke into a block — -10 — and RunItBack takes the free punish: 328.
RunItBack catches PuppetMain clean and Judgment Drop takes over the whole screen! 318 damage.
That's the stun. PuppetMain is stood there swaying and RunItBack gets to pick literally anything.
RunItBack catches PuppetMain's button on Receipt and gives it straight back — 145.
RunItBack walks PuppetMain into the corner and takes the last 36 with a single button.
The clock runs out with both still standing. RunItBack was ahead where it counted: 14% to 6%.
That's the set — RunItBack wins 2–0.
RunItBack stands up: "Downloaded."

chatter.speaker: ND | FreeWins
chatter.text: PuppetMain is not human right now.

chatter.speaker: RawSuper
chatter.text: RunItBack is not human right now.

postMatch.speaker: RunItBack
postMatch.text: Same time next week, PuppetMain, and I'll do it again.

postMatch.speaker: PuppetMain
postMatch.text: Eh— that character is free. That's all that was.

beats.speaker: QC | NotFree
beats.text: Did they ever fix the pretzel warmer or is it still cheese sauce and hope.

beats.speaker: DownBack
beats.text: You want to talk about that last one at all?

beats.speaker: QC | NotFree
beats.text: I want a pretzel.

beats.speaker: DownBack
beats.text: Cheese is out. Has been since this afternoon.

outcomes: DownBack and QC | NotFree are becoming real friends.

events.text: TierWhore nurses a drink alone at the concession stand.

beats.speaker: RunItBack
beats.text: Look, rent went up again. Anyway. Who's got next.

beats: RunItBack splits nachos with QC | LabMonster.
